verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.numeral.com that indexes the docs as Markdown pages. Numeral also ships agent-oriented docs: Claude skills, which are self-contained Markdown files that teach an AI coding agent the calculate → commit → refund lifecycle and its pitfalls. missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice, evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.numeral.com/llms.txt # Numeral API
Claude skills that teach an AI coding agent how to integrate the Numeral tax API correctly.
A skill is a self-contained Markdown file that teaches the agent the calculate → commit → refund lifecycle
